metadata.description: The OpenRouter Responses API with fal, powered by OpenRouter, provides unified access to a wide range of large language models - including GPT, Claude, Gemini, and many others through a single API interface.

RouterOpenaiV1ResponsesInput.description: OpenAI-format request. This endpoint is an OpenAI-compatible passthrough to OpenRouter's Responses API: the request body follows the OpenAI Responses wire format and is forwarded with minimal normalization (usage accounting is enabled, and when a fal caller id is available, a privacy-preserving hash of it replaces any caller-supplied `user`); the response follows the OpenAI wire format, including the Responses API `usage` token fields (`input_tokens`, `input_tokens_details`, `output_tokens`, `output_tokens_details`, `total_tokens`) plus `cost`, the USD cost used for fal billing; other upstream `usage` fields are not returned. When `stream` is true on a synchronous invocation, the response is delivered as server-sent events instead of a single JSON object. Authoritative behavior, including which fields each model accepts, is defined by OpenRouter's implementation (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference); see also the OpenAI Responses API reference (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses). Any field accepted there is accepted here, subject to the normalization above. Fal also accepts optional `image_urls` (HTTP(S) URLs or base64 image data URLs, up to 16 MiB decoded per inline image). These are appended as native image parts to the final user message, or a new user message if the final item is not a user message; the convenience field is removed upstream.

image_urls.description: Optional HTTP(S) image URLs or base64 image data URLs (up to 16 MiB decoded per inline image) appended to the final user message.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Run any LLM (Large Language Model) with fal, powered by OpenRouter.
This endpoint is compatible with the OpenAI Responses API. The Responses API
is a stateful API that combines reasoning, tool calling, and conversation in
one unified experience.
